items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 10, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Benny Powell said, “No art was ever created by happy people.”

ctx.x: the environment. Now you have other artists that just play or create art for the purpose of marketing and selling. You say well I’m going to create this music because I know I’m going to put this music together in a way that it’s going to reach a certain market and I’m going to sell it to this market, because I know what they want. So you have artists, like smooth jazz artists maybe, like today, that will create music for that because they know they can get a lot of money, if they can get a deal to put it out and…
Yes. Benny Powell said, “No art was ever created by happy people.”
